Integrating |K(x,y)| on each arm gives center 5/3 and leaf i (7S+3ell_i)/(3(S+ell_i)); strict triangle inequality for interior points makes vertices the only maximizers. The function decreases strictly in ell_i; h<=S/m gives exact attainable range, h<S/3 gives >2, and P1=1 implies negative excursion half the signed kernel deficit.
